Download **LootLedger.exe** and run it. No install needed. If you have 0.8.1, LootLedger updates itself: it installs this version the next time you close it. If you have 0.8.0, download this one once.

## What's new in 0.8.2

- **Taskbar icon.** LootLedger now shows its icon on the taskbar and in Alt+Tab, instead of a blank one.
- **New README** with screenshots and GIFs of every page (made with demo data).

## First launch

1. In Fortnite: **Settings → Game → Replays → Record Replays: On**.
2. Open LootLedger and play. Finished matches are added automatically.

The exe is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time (More info → Run anyway). It is built from this repository's source by GitHub Actions. Data is saved in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\LootLedger`. The update check and download are LootLedger's only internet traffic; none of your data is sent.

## Not yet verified

This is the first version the 0.8.1 updater can install, so the update itself is being tested for the first time. Also not yet verified: a live match from start to finish, the pop-out counter over Fortnite, global shortcuts, dragging dashboard cards, Windows Snap on several monitors and display scaling above 100%. See [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/femboypuppy/LootLedger/blob/main/VALIDATION.md).
